Horsehead Corporation, located at 300 Frankfort Road in Monaca, Pennsylvania, is a specialty chemical company with deep roots in the metals and chemicals industries. Traditionally known for production and processing of zinc and zinc-based products, Horsehead has developed capabilities spanning metallurgical concentrators, electroplating and alloy services, and the manufacture of zinc oxides and other specialty chemical feedstocks used across a wide range of industrial applications. Companies like Horsehead typically serve markets such as rubber and tire additives, corrosion prevention, chemical intermediates, pharmaceuticals, and various coatings and pigments industries, leveraging metallurgical expertise to supply high-purity metal-derived materials.

Operating at a site in an industrially established region, Horsehead integrates manufacturing and materials-handling capabilities with logistics and regulatory compliance to meet customer specifications and safety standards. The company’s work frequently involves careful environmental, health, and safety practices given the nature of metal processing—emphasizing emissions control, waste management, and worker protection. Community engagement and site stewardship are common priorities for long-standing local manufacturers, which often collaborate with local authorities and environmental agencies to manage operations responsibly.

As a supplier to downstream manufacturers, Horsehead’s role is to translate raw metal sources into consistent, quality-controlled chemical products that enable performance-critical applications. Whether serving the automotive, chemical, construction, or consumer goods sectors, the organization’s technical know-how in refining, formulation, and quality assurance supports customers’ needs for reliable supply and material performance. For more detailed, up-to-date information about Horsehead Corporation’s product lines, environmental initiatives, or corporate structure, consult the company’s official communications or filings.
